credit.title: Bear with Cubs, Denali National Park and Preserve
credit.author: National Park Service

species: Brown bear (Ursus arctos) cubs mewling beside their mother in Denali National Park, Alaska. Used for the polar bear because no polar bear recording under an allowed licence was found; brown bears are the polar bear's closest relative
note: US government work (NPS Natural Sounds gallery). Excerpt stops before a clipped transient at 3.2 s in the source. No high-pass: no measured low-frequency rumble.
